newsitem.title: USA: Intl Absorbents suspends purchase talks.
newsitem.headline: Intl Absorbents suspends purchase talks.

text.p: International Absorbents Inc on Monday said it has suspended previously announced discussions to acquire First Empire International Ltd, a holding company with timber assets in Fiji.
The two companies had signed a letter of intent in April.

"As a result of senior management's investigations in Fiji, particularly First Empire's short-term funding requirements, and considering the recent trading price of the company's shares, the board determined that funding First Empire will result in unacceptable dilution to existing shareholders," Gordon Ellis, chairman, said in a statement.
In addition, International Absorbents said it has canceled an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders set for May 16 because of a Nasdaq decision to delist the company's stock.
The meeting was being held to approve a consolidation of International Absorbents' stock on a one-to-five ratio which would have satisfied Nasdaq's minimum bid requirement.
